1. **Investigated**: Found checkout-api running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` (on-call has been paged) documenting the failure, the rollback, and its verification, with a note that v2.3.1 should be root-caused before any re-deploy.
